description_en: Restores RDS SQL Server backup data to an existing instance or a new instance
description_zh: 该接口用于将RDS SQL Server备份数据恢复到已有实例或新实例上
name: RecoveryDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the new instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage capacity of the new instance. Unit: GB. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html.

The disk space of the new instance cannot be smaller than that of the original instance
parameters.help_zh:
新实例存储容量。单位：GB。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html。

新实例的磁盘空间不能小于原实例的磁盘空间
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the new instance. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
新实例付费类型：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the new instance. Valid values:
Classic: classic network.
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).

Default value: the network type of the original instance
parameters.help_zh:
新实例网络类型：
Classic：经典网络
VPC：专有网络

默认与原实例网络类型一致
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the original instance.

If you want to recover data by backup set (by specifying the BackupId parameter), this parameter is optional.
If you want to recover data to a point in time (by specifying the RestoreTime parameter), this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
原实例ID。

按备份集恢复（即指定BackupId参数）时，本参数不是必须项。
按时间点恢复（即指定RestoreTime参数）时，本参数为必须项
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the target instance
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database name. To restore data to a new instance, use the following format: `Original database name 1,New database name 2`.

To restore data to an existing instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628854.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，恢复数据至新实例时格式为：`原库名1,新库名2`。

如需恢复到已有实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628854.html
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID. You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query backup sets.

If you specify this parameter, the DBInstanceId parameter is optional.

You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID，可通过查询备份列表接口DescribeBackups获取。

指定此参数时，DBInstanceId参数为可选。

BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: Any point in time within the backup retention period. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). If you specify this parameter, the DBInstanceId parameter is required. You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 指定此参数时，DBInstanceId参数为必须。 BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the new instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the new instance. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 新实例虚拟交换机ID，多个值用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the new instance. The IP address must be within the IP address range of the specified vSwitch. By default, the system automatically assigns an IP address based on the values of VPCId and VSwitchId
parameters.help_zh: 设置新实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the new instance. Valid values:
If Period is set to Year, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 3.
If Period is set to Month, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 9.

This parameter is required if PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定新实例购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~3。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

若付费类型为Prepaid则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration of the new instance. Valid values:
Year: year.
Month: month.

This parameter is required if PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定新的预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若参数PayType=Prepaid，该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type of the new instance. Valid values:
local_ssd/ephemeral_ssd: local SSD.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD cloud disk.
cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD) cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
新实例存储类型，取值：
local_ssd/ephemeral_ssd：本地SSD盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type
